title: Safe-area margin container for notches and system bars
problem: HUD and menu buttons end up under camera cutouts, rounded corners or gesture bars on phones.
approach: A MarginContainer maps DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area() from screen pixels into viewport units (viewport size / screen size) and re-applies on viewport resize, so it works with any stretch mode and rotation.
prerequisites: HUD/menu content as children of the container, anchored full rect
integration: lopodev knowledge apply godot-safe-area --project projects/<slug> --godot-dir projects/<slug>/godot
Wrap HUD and menu roots in SafeAreaMargin (full-rect anchors)
expected_behavior: Content insets by exactly the unsafe band in viewport units; with no reported safe area only extra_margin applies.
limitations: Mapping validated headless with injected rectangles; real device cutout reporting NOT RUN
